run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script to generate VASP input files for the top k best adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted cache
run_vasp_relaxation_inputs: run the script with default flags to write VASP relaxation input files for the top k configs per system
run_vasp_single_point_inputs: run the script with the --sp flag to write VASP single point input files instead of relaxations
generate_vasp_paths_list: generate a paths_list.txt file containing all VASP input directories for batch submission of DFT calculations
extract_top_k_cache: extract and save the top k best configurations per system from a process_mlrs cache into a new pickle file
